line: A one-reel silent comedy: locked wide shots, intertitles, a piano in the pit and a flickering print.
line_cn: 一卷默片喜剧：固定的全景、字幕卡、乐池里的钢琴和闪烁的胶片。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: A 4:3 silver print: flicker, weave, scratches, burnt edges, slightly undercranked motion.
Nobody speaks; beats are told by action in wide shots and by intertitle cards.
The camera is heavy: most shots locked, the occasional tracking shot on a cart.
The only sound is a cinema instrument and the projector.
Gags are mechanical chains the audience sees whole.
not: Not noir: no hard mood shadows, no voice-over.
Not a sepia filter on modern footage: the acting, framing and speed are period.
Not a Chaplin impression: no borrowed costume, walk or moustache.
materials: Orthochromatic look: pale skies, dark reds, soft halation on whites.
Print damage: scratches, dust, flicker, gate weave, a vignette.
Period sets and costume; painted backdrops allowed.

rules: Monochrome silver; tinting per section (amber day, blue night, rose romance) is allowed, one tint per section.
Values carry everything: dark clothes against pale walls, pale faces in dark rooms.
At most one hand-coloured element, or none.
colour.examplePalette: silver #d9d4c7, mid #8b877c, black #1b1a17; tints amber #c89a4a, blue #4a6a8a

type.titleFont: an Art Nouveau or engraved serif, white on black card with a decorative border
type.placement: intertitle cards between shots, 3–5 s each, by the assembler
rules: Intertitles are full-frame cards; never burn text over the picture.
Slightly fast (undercranked) action; performers act with the whole body.
Big, readable gestures; a held look to camera is allowed.
Chaos rises with speed and print damage together.

grammar.expresses: cause and effect seen whole; the wait is the joke
attention on one thing; a beginning or end

framing: Wide and medium shots; keep close-ups inside an iris.
Performers face the camera as on a stage.

foley: none: the piano plays every event (a chromatic creep, a cluster for a crash, a glissando for a fall)
sound.ambience: the projector: lamp click, motor purr, film flapping
sound.silence: the piano stops; only the projector; it frames a held moment
sound.musicDefault: upright piano, photoplay idiom, mickey-mousing every event

nativeMoves.name: The chain in one take
nativeMoves.what: A triggers B, B leaves, the audience waits, B returns and hits C.
nativeMoves.build: a 15 s static els shot, beats for each link; continuous link for a second take if longer.

nativeMoves.name: The intertitle twist
nativeMoves.what: A card reframes the next shot in a few words.
nativeMoves.build: assembler intertitle between two shots; the second shot is a cut.

nativeMoves.name: Iris on the look
nativeMoves.what: An iris stops halfway so a character can glance at the audience.
nativeMoves.build: assembler iris transition over a cu shot ending on a look to camera.

nativeMoves.name: Undercranked chaos
nativeMoves.what: Speed and print damage rise together.
nativeMoves.build: pace frantic, vfx speedramp, texture 8mm on the climax shot.

pitfalls.problem: The model renders clean modern monochrome.
pitfalls.fix: texture 8mm, vfx none; say 'scratched flickering 1920s nitrate print, slightly fast motion' in the suffix.
No dialogue field; describe 'exaggerated silent acting, mouths closed or mouthing'.
Keep ms or wider; iris added in the assembler.

look.palette: monochrome silver nitrate print with halation, amber or blue tint per section
look.camera: locked wide and full shots, a cart tracking shot, iris in and out
look.lighting: flat daylight or arc-lamp stage light, pale skies

engine.beatSuffix: A flickering 1920s silent-film print, exaggerated silent acting, slightly fast motion.

decides: which shot gets the tracking cart
structures: a courtship in three failed gifts
openings: the curtain opens on a title card
an iris opens on the hero asleep
a locked wide of an empty street before the crowd
endings: iris on a kiss or a wink
the chain completes a second time, correctly
the film burns in the gate
